summary: City-County Council voted 23-1 on August 10, 2026 to bar new data center construction in Marion County through the end of 2027. Three already-approved projects are exempt.

source.citation: datacenterbans.com Indiana page; dcmap.us policy tracker

notes: Preceded by a non-binding resolution urging the Metropolitan Development Commission to pause approvals, and by a committee vote of 10-3 on July 13 2026. The Metropolitan Development Commission separately approved a pause on new permits through the end of 2027.
